About the role

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

  • Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

  • Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work

  • Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team

  • Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance

 

What you'll get

  • Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on

  • Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work

  • Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team

  • A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video

  • Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team

 

What you'll need

  • A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts)

  • 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role

  • A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done

  • Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers

  • Operational mindset

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role

  • Experience using AI tools in your own legal work

  • Familiarity with how AI or software products are built

    • Collaborate

    About EH Energy Engineering

    EH Energy is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. In response to the challenges of climate change and the global shift toward decentralized energy, EH Energy provides high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

    To support our rapid growth and bring our systems to global markets, we are seeking a Certification Engineer. In this critical role, you will take full ownership of our product compliance roadmap, bridging the gap between innovative engineering and strict global regulations. You will lead hazard and risk assessments, define certification strategies across international markets (EU, North America, marine), and interface directly with notified bodies and classification societies to ensure our fuel cell systems are safe, fully compliant, and market-ready.

    This role requires a full-time, on-site presence at our office in Nyon, Switzerland. We are unable to offer remote or hybrid arrangements, so candidates should be based locally or prepared to relocate.

     

    Key responsibilities

    Certification strategy and project management

    • Identify applicable directives, regulations, harmonised standards and class rules early in the development cycle and translate them into design requirements (EU, North America, marine)

    • Select and manage notified bodies, NRTLs, classification societies and test laboratories, own budgets, schedules and contracts for certification work

    • Plan and witness type tests, factory acceptance tests (FAT) and site acceptance tests (SAT)

    Safety engineering and risk analysis

    • Lead risk assessments to ISO 12100 and hazard studies (HAZID, HAZOP to IEC 61882)

    • Lead design and process FMEA (IEC 60812) for stacks, balance of plant, containers and fuel processing

    • Run explosion-protection assessments: hazardous area classification (IEC 60079-10-1), ventilation and gas detection concepts, and equipment selection

    • Specify and verify safety functions to ISO 13849 (PL) and IEC 61508, including safety requirement specifications and validation reports

    Compliance and technical documentation

    • Compile and maintain technical construction files, CE Declarations of Conformity, type-approval dossiers and certification reports

    • Write and review user, installation, operation and maintenance manuals, safety instructions and labelling

    • Maintain the standards register and assess the impact of new or revised standards

    • Manage certification change control: assess design changes for impact on existing certificates

    Collaboration and continuous improvement

    • Act as the internal authority on certification scope: ensure in-service conformity of series production with certified designs, and support procurement and supply chain on material and packaging compliance (e.g. RoHS, packaging regulations).

    • Support design reviews and supplier qualification, including component certificates (ATEX, PED, electrical)

    Standards and regulatory scope

    The role covers, but is not limited to, the frameworks below. Working knowledge of most is expected; deep expertise in several is required

    • IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1:2021, ISO 16110-1 and Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230

       

    Required qualifications

    • Master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, chemical, process or safety engineering, or equivalent

    • 5+ years in product certification, compliance or safety engineering for complex electromechanical or process equipment (energy, gas, process, machinery or marine)

    • Direct experience with hydrogen or fuel cell systems and the IEC 62282 series, CSA/ANSI FC 1 or ISO 16110

    • Proven track record of taking products through CE marking and third-party certification with notified bodies or NRTLs

    • Hands-on experience leading FMEA, HAZOP and risk assessments, and documenting them to auditor standard

    • Solid knowledge of ATEX / IECEx, hazardous area classification and explosion-protection concepts

    • Experience specifying and validating safety functions to ISO 13849 and/or IEC 61508

    • Excellent technical writing: clear, structured, audit-ready technical files and manuals

    • Fluent English, written and spoken

       

    Preferred qualifications and personal profile

    Nice to have

    • Marine type approval with a classification society (DNV, LR, BV, ABS) or IGF Code projects

    • Experience with fuel processing, reformers or fire equipment, and with pressure equipment under PED

    • Certified functional safety qualification or ATEX/IECEx competence certification

    • Familiarity with North American codes (NEC, NFPA) and UL/CSA certification

    Personal profile

    • Rigorous and structured, with a strong safety mindset and an eye for detail

    • Pragmatic: finds compliant solutions that keep development moving

    • Confident communicator with engineers, auditors, authorities and customers

    • Self-driven in a fast-growing, scale-up environment; comfortable owning topics end to end

       

    Start date: Immediately

    Build with us

    Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

    Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

    With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

    We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

    Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

    Your impact

    Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

    This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

    You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

    What you'll ship

    • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

    • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

    • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

    • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

    • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

    • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

    What you'll bring

    • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

    • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

    • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

    • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

    • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

    • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

    Grow your way

    At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

    You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

    No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

    Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

    If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

    Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

    AI at Mollie

    We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

    AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

    Who We Are

    You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

    We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

    Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

    Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

    Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

    WHO YOU ARE

    You are a commercial leader who has built the go-to-market of a platform from a blank page and knows what it takes to turn a product that people already use into a business that pays for itself. You have priced and packaged products for marketplaces, brands or merchants, and you have seen the difference between a model that looks good in a spreadsheet and one that a small business owner actually adopts.

    You are comfortable in a B2B2C world: the customer is reached through someone else's channel, the data belongs to the ecosystem, and the money comes from several ends of a transaction at once. You influence without authority, because the teams that execute will rarely report to you. You are rigorous with numbers and plain with people, and you are at ease saying what the evidence shows even when the room expects something else.

    You want to build something that reaches millions of small businesses, you are prepared to work for it.

    THE OPPORTUNITY

    Toqan for Partners is the AI assistant for the merchants across the companies of the Prosus ecosystem: restaurants, pharmacies, hotels, sellers, real estate agencies and car dealers, five million businesses in total. It launched to restaurants on iFood in Brazil in September 2026 and reached 65,000 restaurants in four weeks with no media spend.

    The next twelve months decide how it will become a business: which applications partners pay for and at what price, how value is shared with everyone the partner transacts with, how the uplift is measured and published so the next company embeds, and how the product travels from iFood to the rest of the ecosystem and to India and Europe. You will lead that work, as the owner of the go-to-market and the revenue strategy of Toqan for Partners, alongside the product and technology leads who own what gets built.

    WHAT YOU’LL DO

    Own the commercial model

    Define pricing and packaging for the applications partners pay for, media management, supply, finance and operations, at a fraction of what they spend today and justified by the return they see. Design how Toqan takes part in the value it creates for the other end: take rate on agent-negotiated supply, credit origination, brand and industry media, and cross-sell of the ecosystem companies' own products. Set the rules that keep it honest, starting with the separation between paid placement and recommendation.

    Drive the rollout across the ecosystem

    With the Head of Operations, secure the commitment of each business in the ecosystem: sponsor, distribution, conditional yes and first market. Run the rollout inside each one, working through the teams that own the merchant relationship, and bring the product to its next verticals and markets.

    Build the measurement

    Own the scoreboard: active partners under a strict definition, uplift per business in retention and GMV, cost and value per active partner. Make the uplift the argument that brings the next company in and the evidence behind every pricing decision.

    Structure the partnerships that carry the revenue

    Lead the commercial agreements with distributors, industry, fintechs and the ecosystem companies' commercial platforms, from first conversation to signed terms, and the co-investment models that align their incentives with the partner's.

    Build and lead the team

    Hire and develop a small go-to-market and revenue team, growth on the merchant side, monetisation and analytics, and set its standard for rigour, ownership and candour.

    WHAT YOU BRING

    • Ten or more years in go-to-market, revenue or commercial strategy, with at least one commercial function built from scratch and grown to scale.

    • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging, ideally for marketplaces, retail media, payments or SaaS sold to small businesses.

    • Experience on more than one side of a marketplace: merchants or sellers, brands or suppliers, the platform itself.

    • A track record of adoption at scale with a long tail of small customers, not only of large enterprise deals.

    • Proven ability to move a result through teams that do not report to you, and to work inside another company's channel.

    • Fluency with data: you build the business case, run the analysis and read the uplift yourself, and use AI tooling as a normal part of how you work.

    • Candour, humility and patience: you say what the numbers say, you arrive to learn before you teach.

    • English required; Portuguese or Spanish strongly preferred.

    WHAT WE OFFER

    • Global impact: a product that reaches five million small businesses across Latin America, Europe and India.

    • Ownership: the commercial model of a new business, with the numbers to be judged on and the autonomy to build it.

    • Growth: exposure to the leadership of the group and of its companies, and a clear path into operating roles in the ecosystem.

    • Competitive compensation and the Prosus benefits package for the location of the role.

    Why Prosus?

    At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

    Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

    Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

    Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

    We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

    Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

    What you'll do

    Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

    Digitalisering verandert de manier waarop overheden en publieke organisaties werken, besluiten nemen en dienstverlening organiseren. Tegelijkertijd groeit de behoefte aan praktische oplossingen, toepasbare kennis en slimme instrumenten die organisaties helpen om complexe digitale vraagstukken beheersbaar te maken.

    Wil jij ervaring opdoen binnen een toonaangevend adviesbureau en bijdragen aan vraagstukken op het gebied van digitalisering, data, digitale autonomie en publieke innovatie? Dan is deze stage iets voor jou.

    Dit ga je doen

    Als stagiair(e) binnen het team Digitale Transformatie ondersteun je adviseurs bij uiteenlopende opdrachten voor ministeries, uitvoeringsorganisaties, provincies, gemeenten en andere maatschappelijke organisaties.

    Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

    • Ondersteunen bij onderzoeken, analyses en adviesopdrachten.

    • Voorbereiden en ondersteunen van workshops, werksessies en bijeenkomsten voor opdrachtgevers.

    • Meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van praktische handreikingen, methodieken en kennisproducten.

    • Uitwerken van onderzoeksresultaten naar concrete producten voor opdrachtgevers.

    • Actualiseren en verrijken van onze website, publicaties en online kennisproducten.

    • Structureren, actualiseren en verder ontwikkelen van bestaande kenniscollecties tot een deelbare kenniscatalogus.

    • Uitvoeren van markt- en deskresearch naar ontwikkelingen op het gebied van digitalisering, data en digitale autonomie.

    • Ondersteunen bij de doorontwikkeling van onze digitale-autonomie-quickscan en andere proposities.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of experience as a full-stack or frontend-heavy engineer.

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A read-only list of available tools (name and category only, no owner details), pulled from Convex.

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • Have two roles:

  • admin:

    • Can remove any listing, view all loans, and mark a lender as “Trusted Lender”.

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Automation with n8n

  • Build at least two n8n workflows:

  • Request notification: when a borrow request is created or changes status, Convex calls an n8n Webhook. The workflow notifies the relevant user (email, Slack, Discord, or a logged mock notification is fine) using only the fields it needs.

  • Overdue reminders: a scheduled workflow runs daily, fetches overdue loans from a Convex HTTP endpoint, sends a reminder to each borrower, and writes the reminder status back to Convex.

  • Secure the integration in both directions:

  • Sign webhook payloads (e.g. HMAC with a shared secret) and verify signatures on the receiving side.

  • Keep secrets in environment variables and n8n credentials, never in code or exported workflow JSON.

  • Make write-backs idempotent so retries do not create duplicate records or reminders.

  • Handle failures with retries and an error workflow (or equivalent) so failed runs are visible and never fail silently.

  • (Bonus) Show recent automation activity on each loan in the app, e.g. “Reminder sent 2 days ago”.

Deliverables

  • A GitHub repository with the app source code.

  • Exported n8n workflow JSON files in the repository.

  • A README covering local setup (including n8n, e.g. a docker-compose file), environment variables, architecture, and your security and data-minimization decisions.

  • A short note on what you would change to run this in production.

We evaluate:

  • Code structure and clarity

  • Security-minded thinking

  • UX and practicality

  • Integration design, reliability, and error handling (n8n)

  • Documentation and reasoning

  1. Take-home assignment submission (as described above).

  2. Technical & product interview (walkthrough of your solution, architecture, security mindset, collaboration style).

  3. 6-month contract offer for the right candidate, with strong potential for renewal as a recurring contract based on performance and ownership.

  • Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech.

Why Choose Suddath to “Move” your Career to the Next Level?

At Suddath, you can be part of something special and inclusive! Join a team that has a 100+ year reputation for excellence as an innovative, growing and financially stable company that is dedicated to promoting a culture that thrives on inclusion and diversity. From numerous awards to being recognized as one of the best places to work, Suddath offers a caring, family environment while providing relocation and logistics services to people and companies all around the world.

What We Offer!

  • A competitive wage with a comprehensive benefits package, including a 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Weekly pay for hourly-paid employees. Biweekly pay for salaried employees.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid company holidays
  • A tuition reimbursement plan where employees are encouraged to continue their education and development
  • For more information on our benefit offerings, please visit and scroll down to view our employee benefits.

General position summary:

The COO, Domestic has full responsibility of the domestic business for SGS Move Management, as well as oversight of core functions impacting both domestic and international operations, specifically domestic Network Development, Customer Experience, and Claims. The COO will be responsible for the overall revenue and profitability of SGS’s domestic business, including growing and optimizing the SCAC management base, and building sufficient quality capacity to support growth while meeting or exceeding required quality scores. The COO will be expected to be or grow into a recognized industry leader both from the supply chain / industry perspective as well as the government perspective (i.e., TRANSCOM and the PPA). The COO will also be responsible for overseeing the overall leadership, growth and development of the team, as well as work collaboratively and effectively not only with the President, SGS Movement, but with key peers on the SGS leadership team, namely the COO, International and the SVP, Finance & Accounting.

This individual is driven, enthusiastic, resilient, agile and highly motivated. This role works and collaborates with a team of operational and business leaders to achieve high customer satisfaction and revenue growth through building a SCAC Management revenue base, building quality capacity, driving innovation and efficiency, and negotiating favorable agreements with supply chain partners.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

• Manage the overall domestic P&L by maintaining and growing the stable of SCACs under management, overseeing the development of quality capacity to support volume, and driving operational and customer experience performance to optimize Best Value Scores.

• Stay abreast of government contracting, negotiations, and service provider relationships needed for established and future business.

• Seen as industry leader internally and externally, with the ability to shape industry and program policy direction through influence and leadership..

• Hire, coach and develop logistics management, operations and customer service teams, building on talent and ensuring appropriate successions plans.

• Meet and exceed identified contract proposal commitments, metrics and standards relative to operational performance.

• Provide contract and customer support, maintain key relationships to ensure consistent meeting and exceeding of goals.

• Analyze current methods, and collaboratively improve or implement new processes, workflows, and technology solutions that maximize efficiency.

• Build relationships with key partners, and business leaders ensuring open lines of communication as well as leverage key external relationships.

• Develop and implement strategies for driving efficiency and executing contract requirements at a high level. Anticipate changes in business climate and ensure solutions are in place to meet or exceed them.

• Identify alternative revenue and margin streams

• Preparation and management of all financials. Assist management team in process and efficiency goals. Successful execution of monthly financial goals.

• Develop short and long term plans to ensure logistics resources and practices, at all vendor locations are consistent with Suddath Government Services strategic goals.

• Oversee and ensure compliance with all company standards.

• Other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience:

• Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Economics, Transportation & Logistics and/or relevant experience in the transportation or logistics related field.

• Fifteen plus years logistics experience including a minimum of ten years supervising and developing people and minimize of 5 years with full P&L responsibility for a business or business segment

• Extensive knowledge of either the military HHG program or large-scale government contracted transportation & logistics business is strongly preferred.

• Effective and competent management, leadership and organizations skills required.

• Ability to achieve business results through influence, executive presences, strategic thinking, and effective problem solving.

• Knowledge of P&L and the ability to act decisively based on sound judgement.

• Proficiency in the MS Office Suite of products.

• Ability to function in a fast-paced work environment and tolerate stress

• Ability to plan and organize, has attention to detail and has problem-solving skills.

Language Skills:

· Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

· Ability to write routine reports.

  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Mathematical Skills:

· Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.

· Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

Reasoning Ability:

  • Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.

Computer Operations:

Planning/Organization:

Role overview

We are hiring a VP of Product to lead two strategic priorities: accelerating business performance through AI-driven innovation and unlocking new revenue opportunities through a data-as-a-service (DaaS) offering built on the wealth of data and insights across our platforms.

You will identify opportunities to simplify workflows, enhance productivity and improve how teams operate through the thoughtful adoption of AI agents and automation. Working collaboratively across the business, you'll build a network of AI champions to drive innovation, share best practices and scale adoption.

You'll also establish the frameworks, governance and enterprise controls needed to deploy AI solutions safely, responsibly and at scale, ensuring we build sustainable capabilities that deliver measurable value across Xplor.

You are an AI-native product leader: you build with AI yourself, measure everything, and hold automation and data products to clear quality, cost and risk standards.

What you'll do

Build a network of AI champions

  • Recruit and train champions in every function and business unit to spot, build and own automations.
  • Give champions playbooks, low-code tools, office hours and a clear path from idea to approved production workflow.
  • Recognize and share wins so adoption spreads across teams.
  • Lead change management: training, communications and support so people trust and use what gets built.

Find and guide automation of repeatable processes

  • Collaborate with champions to identify high-volume, repeatable processes across support, onboarding, finance, HR, sales operations, engineering and back office
  • Size each opportunity by hours saved, cost, cycle time and quality, and keep one ranked automation backlog for the company.
  • Design AI-native workflows that create step function efficiency gains.
  • Build reusable components (connectors, prompts, evals, templates) so each automation ships faster than the last.
  • Set baselines and report savings and productivity gains against them.

Run thousands of agents with enterprise controls

  • Define the operating model for agents and workflows: intake, approval, build, test, deploy, monitor and retire.
  • Stand up a central registry so every agent has an owner, a purpose, the data and systems it can reach, and a risk tier.
  • Partner with Security and IT on identity and least-privilege access for agents, secrets management, audit logs and kill switches.
  • Set evaluation and monitoring standards: accuracy, drift, cost per task, failure rates and escalation to humans.
  • Prevent sprawl: catch duplicates, enforce shared components, and retire agents that no longer earn their keep.
  • Help functions manage AI spend with budgets, model routing and usage reporting by team.

Build and monetize the data-as-a-service offering

  • Turn systems of record data into insight products: industry benchmarks, spend and demand trends, cash-flow forecasts, risk signals and next-best-action recommendations.
  • Define target customers (our SMB customers, enterprise partners, financial institutions or other third parties) and the problems each will pay to solve.
  • Own pricing and packaging: subscriptions, tiers, usage-based APIs, embedded dashboards and premium add-ons.
  • Work with Data Engineering to build AI-native data foundations: ingestion, transformation, normalization, categorization, entity resolution, quality and lineage.
  • Use AI to make the data understandable: natural-language querying, summaries and explanations customers can act on.
  • Take products from validation to launch, with go-to-market, enablement and customer success plans.

Build in privacy, security and compliance

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security and Risk so every data product has a clear legal basis, consent and contract rights for the data it uses.
  • Set standards for aggregation, anonymization and minimum cohort sizes so no customer, cardholder or individual can be identified.
  • Keep payment card data out of scope for insight products and meet PCI DSS and data protection requirements in each region (for example, GDPR and UK GDPR, Australian and New Zealand privacy law, and US state privacy laws), with Legal confirming the specifics.
  • Apply the same governance to internal automations that touch customer or employee data.

What you bring

  • 12+ years in product management, with 5+ years leading product leaders in B2B SaaS or vertical software.
  • A track record of taking data, AI, or ML products to market and showing revenue impact, not just pilots.
  • AI-native builder: you prototype with AI coding and agent tools and use AI daily in your own work.
  • Experience shipping AI-first products, including agentic workflows and human-in-the-loop design.
  • Evaluation-driven product practice: building eval sets, setting quality thresholds and monitoring AI in production.
  • Hands-on experience with pricing and packaging of AI features, including usage-based models and inference cost trade-offs.
  • Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval and evaluation, enough to challenge engineers and explain trade-offs to executives.
  • Strong grounding in data foundations: quality, governance, privacy and what makes data AI-ready.
  • Experience with responsible AI and regulatory frameworks across multiple regions.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence in a multi-BU or federated organization.
  • Clear communicator who can teach, simplify and present to executives and boards.

Nice to have

  • Time in a product, strategy, consulting or venture role sizing AI opportunities.
  • Experience setting up an AI center of excellence or central pod model.
  • Familiarity with AI management standards such as ISO/IEC 42001 or the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Before you apply

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is advertised. This applies to remote roles too. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

Interview Recording and Background Checks

As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.

EEO and Artificial Intelligence

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

We're dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status and age. Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

In this role you will help protect innovations that can improve the lives of patients with severe autoimmune diseases, while building intellectual property (IP) litigation and contested-matter strategy. We are seeking an experienced US patent attorney who combines recent and substantial BPCIA and/or ANDA patent litigation expertise, scientific curiosity and commercial judgment with an appetite to shape and support our pipeline and improve how a modern IP team works.


Litigation, contested matters and dispute readiness will be your primary focus, but you will also partner with the broader IP team to bring a litigation perspective to patent portfolio building and act as lead attorney for a focused portfolio of preclinical and clinical projects and programs. Program allocation will preserve capacity to lead disputes and will be reviewed with the Global Head of IP as contested-matter demands evolve.


You will work closely with colleagues across the Legal, Compliance and Intellectual Property (LCIP) team, including the Head of Litigation and Enforcement, to align IP dispute strategy with broader legal and business priorities. You will also help drive an evolving agentic IP team: attorneys and IP professionals working alongside artificial intelligence (AI) agents that carry out defined, multi-step workflows under appropriate human direction and review.


Core Responsibilities:

  • Patent Strategy and Portfolios: Develop creative, business-aligned protection and enforcement strategies, leveraging your litigation experience to drive portfolio value. Build and manage global portfolios and oversee patent preparation, filing and prosecution in the United States, Europe and other key jurisdictions throughout the world.
  • Disputes and Litigation Readiness: Strengthen litigation readiness and lead or support patent disputes in coordination with the internal team and external counsel. Connect prosecution, records and enforcement strategy.
  • Litigation and Contested-Matter Leadership: Lead global IP dispute strategy and execution in close partnership with the Head of Litigation and Enforcement, other LCIP colleagues and external counsel. Cover patent litigation, biosimilar disputes, patent-office challenges and oppositions, and related trade secret or contractual disputes; align positions across jurisdictions and related matters.
  • Scientific and Business Partnership: Act as strategic IP partner to global project teams responsible for key drug candidates across argenx’s portfolio. Translate complex science and patent issues into clear recommendations that support product development, commercialization and long-term portfolio value.
  • Invention and Disclosure Management: Work with scientists to identify and protect inventions, assess inventorship, manage public disclosures and strengthen trade secret protection.
  • Risk and Competitive Assessment: Conduct infringement, validity, freedom-to-operate and competitive landscape analyses, identifying actionable risks and opportunities.
  • Transactions and Agreements: Lead patent-related diligence and support licensing, collaborations, partnerships, mergers and acquisitions. Review, draft and negotiate IP provisions and agreements, including confidentiality, technology transfer and licensing arrangements.[KM5.1]
  • Portfolio Execution: Manage external counsel and business partners, align priorities and resources, and deliver portfolio reviews, long-range planning and special projects.
  • Case Assessment and Resolution: Evaluate infringement, validity, enforceability, evidence and business exposure. Develop enforcement, defense and settlement options, communicate recommendations and decision points, and seek appropriate internal approvals.
  • Matter Management: Select and direct external counsel in global IP litigations and contested matters in collaboration with the Global Head of IP; oversee case plans, budgets, discovery, experts, witnesses and key submissions. Liaise closely with the Head of Litigation and Enforcement and relevant LCIP colleagues on material risks, escalation, resourcing and coordinated matter management.
  • Litigation Readiness: Lead pre-dispute planning and biosimilar readiness. Work with LCIP colleagues and relevant business teams on evidence preservation, legal holds and witness preparation, and strengthening invention, prosecution and development records.
  • Selected Program Leadership: Lead patent strategy for a focused set of assigned programs, including global portfolio development, prosecution, invention and disclosure management, and freedom-to-operate assessment. Maintain close scientific and business partnerships.
  • Teamwide Strategic Input: Partner with program attorneys to strengthen defensibility and enforcement options across the portfolio. Feed lessons from disputes into prosecution and trade secret practices without assuming ownership of every program.
  • Transactions and Agreements: Support selected diligence, licensing and collaboration matters, with particular attention to dispute exposure, enforcement rights and litigation-control provisions. Balance these assignments against contested-matter priorities.

Help Build an Agentic IP Team

This is a role for someone who wants to help build the next way of working, not simply use the tools already available. You will bring curiosity, practical experimentation and the judgment to distinguish where agents add value from where attorney-led work remains essential.


  • Identify and Test Opportunities: Help pilot approved agent-assisted workflows for dispute monitoring, evidence chronologies, document triage, reference verification and matter reporting. Start with bounded use cases and improve them through feedback.
  • Maintain Accountable Legal Oversight: Define tasks, authoritative inputs, review checkpoints and escalation rules. Verify outputs and references, protect confidential and privileged information, respect data-use restrictions, and retain attorney accountability for legal advice and consequential decisions.
  • Build Team Capability: Partner with IP operations, technology and other colleagues to turn useful pilots into repeatable practices. Share learning, coach colleagues and assess improvements in quality, responsiveness and capacity, not simply tool usage.

Required Qualifications:

  • US Legal Credentials: A Juris Doctor (JD) degree, active membership in good standing in at least one US state bar, and registration to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO).
  • Life Sciences Patent and Litigation Experience: At least eight years of life sciences patent experience, including substantial hands-on US BPCIA or ANDA patent litigation or contested-matter experience and demonstrated ability to lead complex disputes or major workstreams. Large-molecule experience is required.
  • Integrated Patent Judgment: Ability to connect litigation risk and enforcement objectives with portfolio development, prosecution and business strategy, and to lead selected programs alongside contested matters.
  • Curiosity and Appetite for Agentic Working: A genuine, demonstrable appetite and curiosity to help drive an evolving agentic IP team. Willingness to learn emerging AI capabilities, question established processes, experiment responsibly and help colleagues adopt better ways of working is essential.
  • Judgment and Communication: Strong legal and business judgment; the ability to explain complex issues clearly, make practical recommendations and collaborate effectively across scientific, commercial and legal teams.

Preferred Experience:

  • Scientific Training: An advanced life sciences degree, preferably at least a thesis-based master’s degree in biology or a related field.
  • Breadth of Practice: Biosimilar litigation experience is strongly preferred. Patent-office challenges, cross-border disputes, trial or appeal experience, and licensing or settlement negotiations are valuable. Both law firm and in-house experience are welcome; law-firm-only candidates will also be considered.
  • Practical Innovation: Experience improving legal workflows or using AI, automation or knowledge tools is welcome. Prior agent-building experience and coding skills are not required; learning agility, sound judgment and a willingness to experiment are essential.

How You Work

You are inquisitive, collaborative and composed under pressure. You make clear recommendations despite uncertainty, prioritize across disputes and programs, and have a strong appetite to teach and learn. You combine firm advocacy with pragmatic judgment and contribute to argenx’s values of innovation, co-creation, empowerment, excellence and humility.

About DNAstack

At DNAstack, our mission is to power precision medicine by building software that breaks down barriers to responsible biomedical data sharing, discovery, and analysis. We build cutting-edge software and industry standards to help researchers and clinicians analyze sequencing data and make faster, more accurate diagnoses. Our platform supports national and international networks tackling rare disease, cancer, infectious disease, and more.

We’re a nimble, cross-functional team of scientists, engineers, designers, and product thinkers working at the intersection of genomics, software, and cloud technologies. Our mission is ambitious, and so is our team.

The Role

The Platform Engineering Lead sets the direction for the team behind the infrastructure our engineers and customers depend on: GCP and AWS environments, Kubernetes, Terraform and Helm, CI/CD, security and the tooling around them.

This is a player-coach role. You lead the team and stay hands-on: you review code, shape architecture and step in on implementation where it matters. You will own four things: the growth of the people on the team, the team's priorities, the platform roadmap (planned with Product), and the platform's technical direction.

What We Look For in a Lead

  • Direction first. Clear, ranked priorities, and a reasoned "not yet" or "no".
  • Shared ownership. Knowledge, on-call and decisions belong to the whole team, and we learn in the open.
  • Technical credibility. You can read a Terraform plan, review a pull request and challenge an architecture proposal, and your feedback makes people better.
  • Honest trade-offs. You make the cost and risk of every choice visible to the team, to Product and to leadership, including the case for more investment when the work calls for it.

What You’ll Do

Lead the team

  • Manage and grow the team through 1:1s, career conversations, growth plans, performance reviews and hiring.
  • Own the team's rituals, including planning, retrospectives and incident reviews.
  • Build shared ownership with primary and secondary owners, pairing, shared on-call and written decisions.
  • Coach senior engineers and build a culture of individual empowerment, accountability, and collaboration.

Set priorities and the roadmap

  • Keep one ranked list of priorities that everyone can see. Triage requests from Product, Program Management and customers against it, and decide what the team defers or stops.
  • Plan the platform roadmap with Product, so reliability, security, tooling and customer environments are planned alongside product features.
  • Report progress, risks and spend to the VP of Product Development and the leadership team.

Set technical direction

  • Set the direction of the platform and decide how technical decisions are made, documented and revisited.
  • Guide architecture and stay hands-on through design reviews, code reviews and implementation.
  • Settle technical trade-offs across teams and review major changes, including new customer deployments, for cost and risk.

Make every engineer faster

  • Define how we measure delivery, including deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, time to restore and build and test durations, and act on what the numbers show.
  • Set direction for the path from commit to production: fast, reliable CI, preview environments with representative genomic test data, and safe, routine deployments with progressive rollouts and automated rollback.
  • Use AI and deterministic automation to give a small team leverage, with guardrails for agent access and KPIs that track time saved. Own the platform for AI-assisted development: tooling, access, licensing and budget.

Own cost, reliability and security

  • Own the infrastructure budget across GCP, AWS and related tooling: forecast, track against plan and explain variances. Build cost visibility per environment, customer and product.
  • Set cost targets and manage vendor and licensing relationships, with renewals planned well ahead.
  • Own platform reliability: service level objectives for customer-facing environments, a clear rotation for on-call, deployments, alerts and support requests, incident response and blameless reviews.
  • Partner with our Chief Information Officer and Chief Privacy and Security Officer on SOC 2 controls tracked in Drata. You own the technical side: access, secrets, CI and audit evidence.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years in DevOps, site reliability or platform engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers.
  • Experience setting technical direction and priorities for a platform or infrastructure team, and managing senior engineers.
  • Production experience with Kubernetes, Terraform and a CI system on GCP or AWS, and the hands-on skill to review and contribute to that work.
  • Direct accountability for a cloud budget, with examples of cost reductions you delivered and how you measured them.
  • Experience improving developer productivity, with the metrics to show it.
  • A track record of automating repetitive operational work to give a small team leverage.
  • Experience with SOC 2 or a comparable control framework, and comfort working with health or genomic data where access rules are strict and audited.
  • Strong communication, including explaining technical trade-offs and costs to non-technical leaders, and ease working across global time zones.

Nice to Have

  • Concourse CI experience. Our tooling is largely custom, so this is a head start, not a requirement.
  • Experience running many environments from one platform.
  • Experience using AI and automation to multiply output, including guardrails for agent access.
  • Experience building cost allocation or showback models, or internal developer platforms.
  • Familiarity with Java services built on Spring Boot, GA4GH standards or WDL workflow engines.

Why This Role Is Exciting

  • Impact at scale: Your work will directly influence tools used by national and international genomics networks.
  • Build something new: Shape a core function of the company from a small, senior team into a scalable, sustainable group.
  • Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Work side by side with engineers, product managers, and scientists to turn bioinformatics into real-world solutions.
  • Mission-driven: Contribute to solving rare disease, cancer, and infectious disease challenges by enabling precision medicine.
  • Team culture: Enjoy a flexible, remote-friendly team culture along with a competitive salary, benefits, and employee stock option program.

Where You'll Work

This role offers the flexibility of remote work, with the option to work in person from our Toronto office. This arrangement supports your needs and promotes a healthy work–life balance.

Eligibility

To be considered for this position, you must be eligible to work in Canada.

Benefits

  • Remote friendly, with flexible hours and the opportunity to work on-site at our Toronto office
  • Comprehensive health benefits: medical, dental and vision coverage for you and your dependents
  • Three weeks vacation
  • Unlimited sick days
  • Maternity and parental leave top-up programs
  • One-time remote office set-up stipend
  • Career development and learning support
  • Opportunity to participate in DNAstack's Employee Stock Option Program
  • Opportunity to contribute to open science and global data-sharing efforts

About Arctic Kingdom

Arctic Kingdom delivers exceptional travel experiences across Canada’s North. Its portfolio includes Blachford Lake Lodge, a fly-in wilderness lodge near Yellowknife renowned for world-class aurora viewing; Arctic Kingdom Expeditions in the High Arctic; and Torngat Mountains Base Camp in northern Labrador. The organization is guided by its core values: Expertise, Collaboration, Excellence in Service, and Respect for Place & People.

Marketing & Communications

  • Maintain, tag, organize, and update media assets in Canto DAM for easy team access.
  • Monitor and respond to social media messages and comments through Sprout Social in a timely, brand-aligned manner.
  • Draft captions, posts, and digital content; support social media planning, scheduling, and content calendars for manager approval.
  • Support marketing campaigns, promotions, email communications, presentations, including private journey pitch deck requests, and collateral
  • Assist with basic photo/video editing, research, reporting, vendor coordination, and brand consistency across channels.
  • Manage and maintain website content including seasonal pricing updates and merchandise inventory/descriptions.

Sales Support & Guest Onboarding

  • Coordinate post-reservation guest onboarding under the direction of the Guest Services Manager.
  • Use HubSpot CRM and Arrows to manage onboarding workflows, guest records, required forms, and follow-up tasks.
  • Communicate with confirmed guests regarding pre-arrival requirements, travel documentation, and practical arrangements.
  • Assist with flight details, clothing rentals, Yellowknife accommodations and activities, add-on services, and other travel logistics.
  • Track outstanding information and deadlines; prepare and distribute guest documents and pre-departure communications.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Guest Services, Operations, and external providers to ensure accurate handoffs and a seamless guest experience.

Ancillary Revenue Programs & Administration

  • Support the development and ongoing operation of Arctic Kingdom and Blachford Lodge merchandise programs and online stores.
  • Maintain product listings, descriptions, pricing information, order records, and inventory coordination; liaise with suppliers and fulfillment partners.
  • Assist with wholesale equipment sales administration, including quotations, order processing, product information, documentation, and customer inquiries.
  • Support promotion and administration of guest add-ons and other ancillary offerings, including basic reporting and process improvements.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Manage competing deadlines and keep records and task tracking accurate across shared systems.
  • Collaborate with both functional managers to coordinate workload, communicate status, and respond to seasonal peaks and operational priorities.
  • Support special projects and continuous improvements to workflows, guest communications, and internal coordination.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, sales coordination, guest services, hospitality, tourism, or a related field.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, customer service, organization, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities independently and collaborate effectively in a remote, cross-functional team.
  • Experience with CRM systems such as HubSpot; familiarity with onboarding tools such as Arrows is an asset.
  • Experience with social media management tools such as Sprout Social and digital asset management systems such as Canto is preferred.
  • Experience with content creation, email marketing, e-commerce, online store administration, inventory, or order processing is an asset.

About the Role

We are looking for an Inbound Sales Rep to manage and convert incoming leads. In this role, you'll speak with prospective clients, understand their needs, guide them toward the right solution, and consistently follow up to move qualified opportunities through the sales process.

The ideal candidate is confident in sales conversations, organized with follow-ups, and motivated by turning inbound interest into closed business.

Consultative Selling

Pipeline Management & Follow-Up

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.

We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Job Description

As a Sr Manager, Congress Management, at Gilead you will...


Key responsibilities:

As a Senior Manager, Global Congress Center of Excellence, you will play a critical role in managing the execution of congress operations across Gilead and Kite. This position supports the establishment and coordination of Core Congress Committees and Sub-Teams to ensure a standardized, consistent, and best-in-class congress planning process.

This role reports to the Director, Congress Orchestration within the Global Congress Center of Excellence (CoE), part of the Global Commercial Operations organization.


Key Responsibilities:

Congress Planning & Execution

•Drive project execution and cross-functional coordination for global Tier 1 and Tier 2 congresses

•Partner with the Congress Orchestrator to develop congress strategies and recommendations aligned with therapeutic area objectives

•Maintain event timelines, ensuring all deliverables are met

•Oversee compliance reviews and VEM processes

Committee & Team Leadership

•Support and lead Core Congress Committees and Sub-Teams, ensuring clear objectives and alignment with overall strategy

•Facilitate planning cadence for therapeutic area-specific meetings, exhibit booths, and symposia

•Serve as primary point of contact for associations regarding timelines, sponsorships, and program details

Project Management & Operations

•Manage exhibit booth execution and onsite operations, including agency coordination and “run of show” for internal meetings

•Own and maintain asset trackers, congress master decks, and pre-/post-conference materials

•Lead project management platforms (e.g., ASANA) and oversee budget management, including financial reconciliation and cross-charge processes

•Manage work order and purchase order processes for non-logistics vendors and congress sponsorships

Communication & Reporting

•Assist in developing congress communication plans, including leadership updates, newsletters, and meeting agendas

•Ensure metrics are established and tracked to inform future decision-making and elevate the Global CoE to “best in class”

Compliance & Collaboration

•Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Regulatory to ensure all activities and materials meet regulatory standards

•Coordinate closely with Global Congress CoE, U.S., Affiliate teams, and Kite to ensure seamless planning and execution

Travel

•Up to 30%, including domestic and international meetings

Basic Qualifications:

•Bachelor’s Degree and Eight Years' Experience

OR

•Master’s degree and Six Years' Experience

OR

•Advanced Degree (e.g., PharmD, PhD)


Preferred Qualifications:

•Relevant pharmaceutical, biotech or medical device industry experience in congress management, operations, and/or marketing.

•Regional or global experience preferred; U.S. experience essential

•Proven ability to independently lead high-visibility strategic projects, translating strategies into actionable plans with defined resources, tactics, and measurable outcomes

•Exceptional interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with demonstrated success influencing across a matrixed global organization

•Experience engaging senior and executive leadership, presenting strategic plans clearly and concisely for endorsement

•Strong strategic and analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret complex issues and provide innovative, cross-functional recommendations

•Demonstrated excellence in project management, including managing multiple priorities and delivering quality results in fast-paced environments

•Expertise in global pharmaceutical planning, including development and execution of strategic and tactical plans, and budget management


Leadership Expectations:

•Create Inclusion

Champion the value of diverse perspectives within your projects and teams. Model inclusive behaviors and embed diversity principles into collaboration and decision-making processes.

•Influence Without Authority

Build trust and credibility across functions. Leverage strong communication and relationship skills to gain alignment and deliver results without formal reporting lines.

•Empower Teams and Drive Collaboration

Connect teams to organizational priorities by aligning goals and removing barriers. Foster accountability and enable cross-functional collaboration to achieve shared objectives.

•Demonstrate Emotional Intelligence and Professional Maturity

Show adaptability, empathy, and sound judgment in dynamic environments. Maintain composure under pressure and communicate with clarity and respect to build confidence and engagement.


People Leader Accountabilities:

  • Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
  • Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
  • Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

The salary range for this position is:

Bay Area: $146,540.00 - $189,640.00.Other US Locations: $133,195.00 - $172,370.00.

Gilead considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package.       <title>Mixpanel: Customer Value Architect III</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> San Francisco, US (Remote)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p>
<p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="https://mixpanel.com/home/">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About the Team</strong></p>
<p>The Customer Value Architects team sits inside the revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. We turn product usage into measurable business outcomes, working across onboarding, adoption, and renewal to make sure customers see the value they signed up for.</p>
<p><strong>About the Role</strong></p>
<p>The right candidate is a relationship-first advisor who connects a customer's Mixpanel investment to real outcomes for a defined book of accounts. You'll own the adoption and value plan for each account end to end: understanding why the customer bought Mixpanel, tracking whether they're getting the ROI they expected, and driving the enablement and product usage that gets them there. You'll build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders, partner closely with your Account Executive and renewal counterparts, and bring a growing point of view on how customers should think about AI in their product workflows. This role suits someone who can own a project end to end and is ready to start extending their influence beyond their own accounts to the wider team.</p>
<p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Own the value plan for each account in your portfolio, connecting the business problem that led the customer to buy Mixpanel with the outcomes they measure.</li>
<li>Build relationships with business and technical stakeholders, aligning Mixpanel's capabilities to what customers care about most.</li>
<li>Run discovery on customer priorities and pain points, and turn what you learn into concrete adoption plans and internal updates.</li>
<li>Partner with your Account Executive on expansion and your renewal counterpart on renewal execution, bringing the value case and adoption evidence that supports both.</li>
<li>Lead enablement/best practices sessions on dashboard design, funnel analysis, and retention modeling to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.</li>
<li>Monitor usage and health signals and lead business reviews that surface what's working, deepen adoption, and catch risk early.</li>
<li>Spot underused features and contracted capabilities, and turn them into clear recommendations for the customer.</li>
<li>Triage product questions and issues, solving what you can and routing the rest to the right team.</li>
<li>Build a working point of view on a customer's AI maturity, and use Mixpanel's own AI surface to help them build on their product data.</li>
<li>Coordinate with GTM, Product, and Engineering on escalations, and share what works with the broader Customer Value Architects team.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>We're Looking For Someone Who Has</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>4 - 6 years of experience in customer success, consulting, or a related field supporting B2B SaaS accounts, or equivalent experience.</li>
<li>A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from business partners to technical teams.</li>
<li>The ability to translate technical concepts, like data models and product metrics, into terms that land with non-technical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Experience turning product usage into a clear story about customer outcomes and ROI.</li>
<li>Comfort building and running adoption plans that tie daily work to a customer's larger goals.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use, such as MCP-based workflows or LLM copilots.</li>
<li>A collaborative approach to working across account teams and internal partners to move plans forward.</li>
<li>Good judgment for prioritizing which accounts and actions need attention first.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.</li>
<li>Experience in a technical advisory or professional services capacity.</li>
<li>Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.</li>
</ul>
<p>#LI-Remote</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p>
<p><span>The amount listed below is the total target cash compensation (TTCC) and includes base compensation and variable compensation in the form of either a company bonus or commissions. Variable compensation type is determined by your role and level. In addition to the cash compensation provided, this position is also eligible for equity consideration and other benefits including medical, vision, and dental insurance coverage. You can view our benefits offerings <a href="https://mxpnl.notion.site/Check-out-our-benefits-869112a6cabe4c81a2b9da99de28f636">here</a>.<br><br>Our salary ranges are determined by role and level and are benchmarked to the SF Bay Area Technology data cut released by Radford, a global compensation database. The range displayed represents the minimum and maximum TTCC for new hire salaries for the position across all of our US locations. To stay on top of market conditions, we refresh our salary ranges twice a year so these ranges may change in the future. Within the range, individual pay is determined by experience, job-related skills, qualifications, and other factors. If you have questions about the specific range, your recruiter can share this information.</span></p></div><div class="title">Mixpanel Compensation Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$125,500</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$169,500 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong><strong><br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care</li>
<li>Mental Wellness Benefit</li>
<li>Generous Vacation Policy &amp; Additional Company Holidays</li>
<li>Enhanced Parental Leave</li>
<li>Volunteer Time Off</li>
<li>Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break</li>
</ul>
<p><em>*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*</em></p>
<p><strong>Culture Values</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Make Bold Bets:</strong> We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.</li>
<li><strong>Innovate with Insight:</strong> We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive&nbsp;powerful outcomes.</li>
<li><strong>One Team:</strong> We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.</li>
<li><strong>Candor with Connection:</strong> We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.</li>
<li><strong>Champion the Customer:</strong> We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.</li>
<li><strong>Powerful Simplicity:</strong> We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Why choose Mixpanel?</strong></p>
<p>We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.</p>
<p><span>Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.</span></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-customer-value-architect-iii">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mixpanel-customer-value-architect-iii</a></p>
</description>
